shots.alt: A chameleon built in bricks without fresh eyes: a boxy green body striped in orange and blue on a brown branch, its tail a flat squared-off spiral and its pink tongue held straight out.
shots.caption: Without fresh eyes.
features: lib:fresh eyes at the first save

shots.alt: The same brief designed with fresh eyes: a slimmer chameleon with turret eyes and a crest along its back, its tail curled in a round spiral and its tongue out to a fly, on a twisting branch.
shots.caption: With fresh eyes: the same brief.
features: lib:fresh eyes at the first save
